'''Trakri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Republic soldier]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He held the rank of [[Private/Legends|Private]], and he was stationed on the Republic's [[Carrick Station]]. Trakri trained others in the skill of [[Weaponsmith|armstech]], which was the art of making weaponry.
